lines.text: Many learners say: Let me present my friend Ali.
Better: Let me introduce my friend Ali.
Present means give or show. Introduce is for people.
Introduce! Let me introduce my friend.

data.wrong: Let me present my friend Ali.
data.right: Let me introduce my friend Ali.
data.why: Present means give or show. Introduce is for people.

quiz.stem: I want you to meet my friend. Let me ___ my friend.

native.tip: En anglais, “present” veut dire « offrir » ou « exposer ». Pour « présenter » une personne, dites “introduce”.

en.tip: In English, “present” means to give or to show. To introduce a person, say “introduce”.
